evidence:
All five dimensions share one running app/DB: test.sh runs suite 'gates' then 'scored' with rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1, no reset between dimensions; restart_app is single-use and only in functional protocol D. Order inside the scored suite (functional/polish/visual) is not fixed by the task, so every seed-dependent read must be protected regardless of order. Audit of every seed-absolute expectation:
(1) functional Z (prompt.md:25) expects Lena Fischer unread=1 on Product Designer, Platform Engineer Applied=Greta,Ade,Marco / Screen=Priya,Samuel, and Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; seed confirms (APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena read_count 2; APP-105/106/108 Applied positions 1-3; APP-103/104 Screen; note on APP-101). These are protected from other dimensions: render prompt.md:9 'Do not create, move or send anything, and do not open any conversation'; constraints prompt.md:9 only creates own job+candidate with unique email, 'Do not move, reject or message anything'; polish prompt.md:14 'Use your own new job and cards' and :16 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation', polish notes are unsaved and on 'your cards'; visual prompt.md:14 is read-only after gate setup ('Do not move cards or send messages'). Z is also 'Before anything else' within functional, and K forbids signing in as Lena again.
(2) All other functional facts are state-relative: app_context.md:29-31 'Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count'; functional prompt.md:15 'Use your own new jobs and cards ... never move another review's records, and never rely on starting counts'; T fallback to Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation is 'with counts read relative to their values before you act'; U counts are rises (exactly two), Mei's count 'computed from the observed sequence'; hro_thread_latest/earlier grade most-recent-30 and remaining-count consistency, not 120; hro_activity is scoped to J1/J2 and the filter; hro_restart compares D's recorded values plus the Z reading, and Polish/visual cannot change the seeded order or note.
(3) Polish tolerates earlier drafts explicitly (prompt.md:14 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it'), and its live-thread/earlier-place rows on Noor's conversation are relative to what is shown. Visual uses 'a seeded job is fine' read-only, so crafted Likert scoring does not depend on pristine counts. Gate constraints requires 'exactly one card for that candidate' with a unique name, unaffected by prior work.
Counterexample attempts: a polish judge sending into Lena's thread (forbidden by polish:16); visual moving a seeded card (forbidden by visual:14); any dimension running before functional adds jobs/messages (tolerated by app_context:29-31 and relative wording). A conforming app cannot be failed by a sibling dimension's mutation under these prompts. Minor observation (no defect): functional T's 'another conversation' draft step has no explicit 'clear existing text' clause like polish's; if polish ran first and the app persists drafts server-side, a pre-existing draft could be present, but hro_drafts grades only that each conversation keeps its own draft, which still holds, and hro_msg_compose checks the box after a send. Runtime: no full configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope says so), so cross-dimension interaction and actual scored-suite execution order are not measured; this row is a source-design check and the verdict does not rely on a measurement.
